ggsegverse

The ggsegverse is a set of R packages for brain region visualization built on ggplot2. The ggsegverse package makes it easy to install and load the core packages in a single step.

library(ggsegverse)

Core packages

Loading ggsegverse attaches the following packages:

Package Description
ggseg.formats Atlas data structures and S3 classes
ggseg 2D brain region plotting with geom_brain()
ggseg3d Interactive 3D brain visualization
ggseg.meshes Additional cortical and cerebellar surface meshes for 3D rendering
ggplot2 The grammar of graphics that ggseg builds on

ggsegverse is for plotting. To build your own atlases, install ggseg.extra separately.

Installation

You can install ggsegverse from GitHub:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ggsegverse/ggsegverse")

This will also install all core packages that are not already on your system.

Usage

library(ggsegverse) loads and attaches all core packages. On attach, it displays the loaded packages with their versions and any namespace conflicts:

library(ggsegverse)
#> ── ggsegverse ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── 0.0.1 ──
#> ✔ ggseg.formats 0.0.4.9006 ✔ ggseg.meshes 0.0.1.9000
#> ✔ ggseg 2.2.1.9007 ✔ ggplot2 4.0.3
#> ✔ ggseg3d 2.1.2.9003

Find and install atlases

More atlases live on the ggsegverse r-universe:

ggseg_atlas_repos("yeo")
install_ggseg_atlas("ggsegYeo2011")
installed_ggseg_atlases()

Check for outdated packages 

ggsegverse_sitrep()
#> 
#> ── ggsegverse situation report ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> 
#> ── Installed packages ──
#> 
#> ✔ ggseg.formats: 0.0.4.9006
#> ✔ ggseg: 2.2.1.9007
#> ✔ ggseg3d: 2.1.2.9003
#> ✔ ggseg.meshes: 0.0.1.9000
#> ✔ ggplot2: 4.0.3
#> 
#> ── R version ──
#> 
#> R version 4.6.1 (2026-06-24)

List namespace conflicts 

ggsegverse_conflicts()
#> No conflicts detected.

Suppress startup message 

options(ggsegverse.quiet = TRUE)
library(ggsegverse)
